step1_figure.circuit_type: NMOS differential amplifier with PMOS current-mirror active load and cascode tail current source
step1_figure.description: The circuit is an NMOS input differential pair (M1, M2) loaded by a PMOS current mirror (M3, M4) with cascode NMOS tail current source biased by Vbias3 and Vbias4 from a wide-swing cascode bias generator (SUB_1), driving an output load capacitance.

differential_voltage_gain.description: Small-signal low-frequency differential voltage gain Ad

equation.explanation: Differential input voltage creates small-signal current gm*vdi/2 in each branch; the current mirror mirrors id1 to the output node yielding total AC current 2*id = gm*vdi flowing into output resistance ro2 || ro4.
equation.assumptions: M1-M4 operating in saturation region, matched differential pair and mirror.

sky130_expected.calculation: Assuming tail current Iss ≈ 20 uA (ID1 = ID2 = 10 uA), W/L = 10u/1u for NMOS. gm = sqrt(2 * un*Cox * (W/L) * ID) = sqrt(2 * 270u * 10 * 10u) = 232 uA/V. Output resistance ro2 = 1/(lambda_n * ID) = 1/(0.1 * 10u) = 1 MOhm, ro4 = 1/(lambda_p * ID) = 1/(0.1 * 10u) = 1 MOhm. ro2 || ro4 = 500 kOhm. Ad = 232 uA/V * 500 kOhm = 116 V/V ≈ 41.3 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Device channel length modulation and sizing variations typically result in DC gains between 30 dB and 50 dB for standard length devices in SKY130.

f_3dB_bandwidth.description: Output pole -3 dB corner frequency with capacitive load

equation.explanation: The output is the highest-impedance node in the circuit; the dominant pole is determined by parallel output resistance ro2||ro4 and load capacitance Cload.
equation.assumptions: Single dominant pole determined by Cload = 1 pF at high-impedance output node.

sky130_expected.calculation: With ro2 || ro4 ≈ 500 kOhm and Cload = 1 pF: f_3dB = 1 / (2 * pi * 500k * 1pF) ≈ 318 kHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Output resistance is typically 300 kOhm - 1 MOhm depending on biasing and transistor lengths.

equation.explanation: Product of DC gain and 3-dB frequency equals transconductance divided by 2*pi*Cload.
equation.assumptions: Dominant single-pole roll-off up to 0 dB crossover.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined primarily by input pair transconductance gm and Cload = 1 pF.

equation.explanation: Input voltage must be high enough to establish VGS on the input NMOS plus keep the cascode current sink saturated (2*VDS,sat).
equation.assumptions: Cascode tail current sink requires minimum 2*VDS,sat across it to stay in saturation.

sky130_expected.calculation: VGS1 = Vthn + Vov1 ≈ 0.42V + 0.10V = 0.52V. Minimum voltage across cascode current sink is 2*VDS,sat ≈ 2 * 0.12V = 0.24V. V_CMMIN = 0.52V + 0.24V = 0.76 V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Vthn is ~0.42V in SKY130 with overdrive voltages around 100-150 mV.

equation.explanation: To keep input transistors M1/M2 saturated, VD >= VG - VTHN. The drain of M1 is clamped at VDD - VSG3 by the diode-connected PMOS load, giving VG <= VDD - VSG3 + VTHN.
equation.assumptions: M1 and M3 in saturation with balanced DC inputs.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Maximum CM is elevated above drain voltage by one threshold voltage VTHN.

equation.explanation: Output voltage can swing up to VDD minus the saturation voltage of PMOS mirror transistor M4 before M4 enters triode.

sky130_expected.reasoning: PMOS requires at least its saturation voltage VSD,sat to maintain high drain impedance.

equation.explanation: Output can swing down until M2 enters triode when VD2 drops below VG2 - VTHN.
equation.assumptions: Input VI2 held at DC reference voltage.

sky130_expected.calculation: VI2 = 0.50 V, VTHN (with body effect) ≈ 0.45V to 0.50V. V_OUTMIN = 0.50 - 0.45 ≈ 0.05 V (or up to ~0.2 V depending on gate bias).
sky130_expected.reasoning: Limited by the pinch-off of NMOS M2 with fixed gate voltage VI2.

dc_output_voltage.description: Quiescent DC output voltage when differential input is zero

equation.explanation: Due to circuit symmetry and mirror action, the quiescent drain voltage of M4 matches that of diode-connected M3.
equation.assumptions: Matched M1-M2 and M3-M4 with zero differential DC offset.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Equal to VDD minus PMOS threshold and overdrive voltage.
